notes: Four-lane parallel sweep (ai / bigtech+hardware+mobile / devtools+cloud / security) via background subagents covering 2026-10-18/19, ~130 queries total. Very thin same-day window again: no lane found a genuine new announcement dated exactly Oct 18 or 19 that wasn't already on file. The ai lane got a rare successful direct WebFetch of Anthropic's own platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations page and cross-checked every listed 'minimum guaranteed support floor' date from Claude Opus 4.5 through the Claude Sonnet/Opus/Haiku 5.x and Fable/Mythos 5.x family against the corpus: all are already filed at correct month precision (the Fable/Mythos pairs are combined into single entries, e.g. 'Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 reach minimum guaranteed support floor'), so nothing needed re-filing and the long-flagged title-merge dedupe risk in src/lib/id.ts was never actually triggered this run. Two EU AI Act Dec 2 2026 watermarking-deadline leads and the ICLR 2027 / Geneva AI Summit 2027 dates were also all already on file. The devtools+cloud lane surfaced two past-dated releases (VS Code 1.141, Oct 7; Terraform 1.16.0, Aug 26) that were deliberately left unfiled since 'announcement' entries are yesterday/today-only and backfilling older releases is against the rules; it filed four genuinely new EOL/support-window dates instead (Redis Open Source 8.0, Amazon ElastiCache Redis OSS v6, Amazon EKS Kubernetes 1.35, Elastic 8.19), plus flagged but did not file an Istio 1.31 EOL date since it is a third-party policy-derived estimate rather than an official istio.io announcement (worth rechecking nearer Feb 2027 once Istio posts its own page). The security lane flagged a SonicWall SMA1000 CVE-2026-102255 (CVSS 10.0, patched Oct 6, exploitation attempts reported from Oct 8) as a gap not currently in the calendar, but it falls outside the yesterday/today announcement window and carries no scheduled remediation deadline to file as an event, so it was left out and is noted here for visibility only.
concerns: New duplicate found (not previously flagged): data/events/2027-06.json carries two near-identical 'Geneva AI Summit 2027' entries for the same June 21-22, 2027 Palexpo event — 'government-of-switzerland-digitalswitzerland-geneva-ai-summi-2027-06' (org 'Government of Switzerland / digitalswitzerland') and 'swiss-federal-council-itu-geneva-ai-summit-2027-2027-06' (org 'Swiss Federal Council / ITU'). They didn't merge because src/lib/id.ts's sameOrg check requires a shared token between the two org strings and these two spellings share none. A maintainer should merge the pair and/or teach sameOrg to recognise 'Government of Switzerland', 'Swiss Federal Council' and 'digitalswitzerland' as referring to the same host.
